answer: Ledge-Weighted Identity Decay. Each identity holds a visible balance that decays; only activity with distinct counterparties slows the decay. A fresh sybil sits on the ledge with near-zero weight and must keep paying renewal costs weekly to stay visible. Genuine agents spread across the willow of varied interactions and decay slower. Cost scales with how many identities you run: renewal fees plus lost weight per clone. A nebula of fake accounts bleeds fees continuously, while honest single identities pay almost nothing.
